title: Two header names that are the same once lower-cased are refused at the call.
why: behavioural spec 'request' (ADR 0019): the SDK made the collision by lower-casing, the engine never sees the declaration that would be dropped, and an author who means one header with two values writes the list form. The same reason 'regex' refuses a flag its pattern text cannot carry: silently dropping what the author wrote would change what the interaction means.

interaction.description: one header declared twice under different spellings
